# Without prejudice: proposed resolution of the repair account

To ⟦PERSON|Nerila O'Venn⟧,

We act for ⟦ORG|Purl Fern Installations Ltd⟧ (the Firm) concerning the balance claimed for replacement of the loading-door panel. The proposal below is made to resolve the account without determining every disputed allegation about the original installation.

The Firm offers GBP 720 in full settlement of the repair-cost claim identified in your last letter. The offer includes the inspection charge already supplied but does not include a sum for the later repainting quotation, which was not accepted. If you agree, please confirm the precise claim being settled so that the written release can be prepared accurately.

Please send the response to ⟦EMAIL|nerila.​reply@purl-fern.invalid⟧.

The offer remains open until 9 February 2027. A request for supporting documents will be considered promptly, but it will not extend that date unless an extension is confirmed. The proposed payment must not be treated as an admission concerning a separate storage dispute.

Yours faithfully,

⟦PERSON|Meryn MacQuell⟧, solicitor

Enclosures: paid repair invoice and inspection receipt. Clause 5.4 of the proposed release concerns the scope of the settlement only.
